response:
I'm really glad you reached out, and I want you to know that hitting yourself isn't something you deserve—you deserve care, not harm. If those urges ever feel overwhelming or you think about hurting yourself more seriously, please reach out to a crisis line (in the US you can call or text 988) or someone you trust. You don't have to carry this alone.

A breakup after a few weeks doesn't mean you failed or that something is wrong with you. Early relationships often end because two people simply aren't the right fit—and that says nothing about your worth. Compatibility takes time to discover, and one person's choice to leave isn't a verdict on who you are.

You're being incredibly harsh with yourself right now. Could you try speaking to yourself the way you would to a friend in your position? And if this pain keeps pulling you toward self-harm, please consider talking with a counselor who can support you through it.
